description: Asks to put the person's own domain on a project's previews. With git_branch, the domain always shows that one preview's latest version (staging.acme.com shows staging); without it, every preview gets its own address under the domain (fix-header.preview.acme.com), which needs a subdomain, not the bare domain. Owners and admins of the project only. It needs the workspace's preview domains add-on: when the answer says so, start_add_on gives its price and where the person turns it on. Nothing happens until you approve it in CodeGene: the answer gives a link to the request, which waits there for 15 minutes. Send the person that link; you cannot approve it. Then call get_approval with the requestId to learn how it ended. Once approved, the answer of get_approval lists the two records to add where the domain is managed, in that provider's own field names; CodeGene then checks for them, issues certificates and adds preview addresses by itself.

component_id.description: Which part of the project, when it has more than one that can take an address.

domain.description: The domain for previews, such as preview.acme.com or staging.acme.com.

git_branch.description: The one preview the domain always shows, by its git branch name (such as staging). Leave it out to give every preview its own address.

reason.description: Why, in a sentence: kept in the workspace's activity.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: add_preview_domain
title: Use a domain for previews
